claude.lens: Proof-adversarial. Recompute all source substitutions, covariance denominator, factor/sign, one-sided tangent condition, repair lower bounds for arbitrary Hermitian corrections and actual curve sharpness, connected-correlation identity, exact full-rank formula and limit. Search for a counterexample to every retained quantified claim. Check source-domain interpretation against supplied publisher excerpts; distinguish any uncertainty from an actual error.

grok.lens: Complexity/resource and quantitative-scope. Audit all quantifiers and constants, full-rank versus pointwise kernel interpretation, instantaneous versus global repair, arbitrary unequal times, constraints, exact diagnostic limits and the absence of computational/physical claims. Independently recompute the most important formulas and identify missing obligations or exaggerated scope.

agy.lens: Non-claims/attribution. Audit abstract, main claims, README and metadata against the actual proofs and supplied primary excerpts. Is the specific published-equation criticism fair and sufficiently qualified? Check boundary/domain, related literature and novelty limits, unitary correlation evolution, public draft/review/formal labels. Do not treat the packet as independent literature clearance.
